hooks.name: Test File Standards Check
hooks.description: Verifies new test files follow project testing rules

action.prompt: A test file was just created or saved. Quickly verify it follows the project testing rules from ai-agent/.claude/rules/testing-rules.md: (1) no .only or .skip without a comment, (2) no console.log statements, (3) test names follow the "verb + expected outcome [when condition]" pattern, (4) each test follows AAA structure. If you spot violations, report them briefly with the line number. If the file is clean, say nothing.
